name: week
title: This week
subtitle: What needs attention across the project, rendered by npm run view

sections.title: Rule checks
sections.note: Each line cites its rule in docs/compliance.md.
sections.sql: select rule, subject, issue from compliance_issues order by rule, subject

sections.title: Drilling now
sections.sql: select hole, hole_type as type, max_depth as depth_so_far, planned_depth, started_on, rig from hole_status where status = 'drilling' order by hole

sections.title: Lab batches waiting
sections.sql: select dispatch, lab, stage, days_in_stage, samples from dispatch_status where stage <> 'results in' order by days_in_stage desc

sections.title: Tenement reports
sections.sql: select tenement, last_anniversary as year_to, due_on, state from tenement_reports order by due_on

name: qaqc
title: QAQC
subtitle: Standards, blanks and duplicates by batch against the house limits

sections.title: Standards
sections.note: z is the result less the certified value, in standard deviations.
sections.sql: select dispatch, sample, standard_name as standard, element, value, certified_value, z, result from qc_standards order by dispatch, sample

sections.title: Blanks
sections.sql: select dispatch, sample, element, value, detection_limit, result from qc_blanks order by dispatch, sample

sections.title: Field duplicates
sections.sql: select dispatch, sample, original, element, original_value, duplicate_value, diff_pct, result from qc_duplicates order by dispatch, sample

sections.title: Insertion rates
sections.sql: select dispatch, primaries, standards, standards_needed, blanks, blanks_needed, duplicates, duplicates_needed from qc_rates order by dispatch

name: holes
title: Holes
subtitle: Every hole with metres drilled, logged and sampled, and where its results are

sections.title: By hole
sections.sql: select hole, tenement, hole_type as type, status, max_depth, metres_logged, metres_sampled, samples, not_dispatched, awaiting_results, surveys, collar_method as collar from hole_status order by hole

sections.title: Metres by rig and month
sections.sql: select coalesce(contractor, '') as contractor, coalesce(rig, '') as rig, to_char(completed_on, 'YYYY-MM') as month, count(*)::int as holes, sum(max_depth) as metres from holes where completed_on is not null group by 1, 2, 3 order by 3 desc

sections.title: Rehabilitation
sections.sql: select name as hole, status, completed_on, coalesce(capped_on::text, 'not capped') as capped, coalesce(rehabilitated_on::text, 'not yet') as rehabilitated from holes where status in ('complete', 'abandoned') order by completed_on
